grammarFocus: be 动词否定句与一般疑问句；what / who；简短肯定和否定回答。
title: At the School Lost and Found Desk
instructions: 这是模拟练习材料，不是官方考试。请先听录音（或读文字稿），再完成8道题。填空题的答案必须来自原文，并且不超过字数限制。每题只有一个正确答案。
transcript:
A: Good morning. Are you the lost and found teacher?
B: Yes, I am. I am Ms. Li. Are you a new student?
A: Yes, I am. My name is Tom. I am in Class Two.
B: Is this your bag, Tom?
A: No, it is not my bag. My bag is blue. This bag is green.
B: Who is in Class One?
A: Amy is in Class One. Is she here?
B: No, she is not here. She is in the library.
A: Is my blue bag in the library?
B: No, it is not. Your bag is here. It is under the desk.
A: Oh yes! Thank you, Ms. Li.
B: You are welcome. Are you happy now?
A: Yes, I am very happy.

grammar.title: be 动词的否定句与一般疑问句
grammar.explanation: be 动词（am / is / are）表示“是”。否定句在 be 动词后面加 not，例如 is not、are not。一般疑问句把 be 动词放到句子开头，例如“Is this your bag?”。回答时用简短形式：“Yes, I am.”或“No, it is not.”。
grammar.example: No, it is not my bag. My bag is blue.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的否定句：This ___ my bag.
questions.explanation: 主语 this 是单数，be 动词用 is，否定在 is 后加 not，所以是 is not。
questions.evidence: No, it is not my bag.

questions.prompt: 把“She is here.”变成一般疑问句，正确的是：
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句把 be 动词 is 放到主语 she 前面，所以是 Is she here?

questions.prompt: 问“Are you a new student?”，肯定简短回答是：
questions.explanation: 问句用 Are you，回答时换成 I，be 动词用 am，所以是 Yes, I am.
questions.evidence: Are you a new student? ... Yes, I am.

answers: It is not under the desk.
